name: s3-phone
prompt: A sunny street outside a small trading-card shop at midday, seen perfectly straight on and symmetrical, a flat frontal elevation with almost no perspective. The shopfront is painted bright emerald green with thin gold pinstripes; across its top a scalloped red-and-cream striped canvas awning; above the awning a long plain gilded sign board, completely blank. Under the awning one big shop display window with a brass frame: its inside an empty lit display of cream felt with soft sunlight falling across it. Below the window, on the sunny pavement in front of the shop, a long low glass-topped street display cart in honey oak and brass on small wheels, its glass case empty and lined with cream felt, a small plain brass plate on the cart's front, completely blank. Blue sky and a sliver of the neighbouring cream brick buildings at the edges; a potted plant by the door. Layout for a tall phone picture: the blank gilded sign board spans 12% to 88% of the width at 3% to 8% of the height; the awning from 8% to 15%; the display window spans 7% to 93% of the width and 16% to 58% of the height; the street cart's glass case spans 4% to 96% of the width and 68% to 88% of the height, its brass plate centred below it at about 91%. Lighting: bright late-morning daylight. Warm sunlight pours in from a large window off the top left, soft daylight fill everywhere, crisp but light shadows, no black void anywhere: every corner of the picture is lit and readable. The colours are the same family as before but light and saturated: warm cream walls, honey-coloured oak, polished antique brass catching the sun, bright emerald green felt, a touch of tomato red. Style: a painted American comic illustration with modelled depth, crisp black ink contours, cel-shaded light and shade, never a photograph and never a glossy 3D render. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs with writing anywhere. The reference is only for the finish; do not copy its subject. Every shelf, step and display interior stays completely EMPTY: no cards, no slabs, no merchandise, no people.
